verdict.rationale: incident.io documents hosted public and private Status Pages. Workflows can auto-publish to the status page when an incident is updated, so the page is driven from incident state. A Status Page API and agent-driven status updates support this further. However, the evidence never mentions custom domains or subscriber notifications, two explicit elements of the story. Missing for 10: custom domain support, subscriber notification (email/SMS/etc.) evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.
